text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mayano! We're about to have a tea 
party together. Would you like to join us?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I made lots of buono sweets~☆ I'd be so 
happy if you could come over too, 
Maya-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone got together and planned\na 
birthday party for Maya~~♪)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Ehehe, but Maya is a mature woman! I can 
totally play dumb♪)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a tea party sounds fun☆ I'm in, I'm 
in~ Maya wants to eat cake♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm so delighted you accepted my 
invitation, Princess! Now then, allow me 
to escort you to the venue♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Wah☆ Maya gets to be a princess?\nI 
wonder what kind of tea party it'll be~ I 
can't wait~♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of Fuji-san...! Maya-chan 
hasn't caught on to the other surprise at 
all...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(Right, the special guest— Maya-chan's 
papa waiting with the cake!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's right—it's a very special tea 
party, so please try not to be too 
surprised, okay? Princess.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, will they be surprised, I wonder~? 
Fufu, Maya is a big girl now after all~~♪
